Definition: from G4253 and G3708; to behold in advance, i.e. (actively) to notice (another) previously, or (middle voice) to keep in (one's own) view:--foresee, see before.
BiblicalUsage: Proorao means to behold in advance, to foresee. David says he foresaw the Lord always before his face, Paul says the scripture foreseeing that God would justify the heathen preached the gospel to Abraham, and the Jews had seen Trophimus with Paul in the city before.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that foreseeing the Lord before my face is the secret of standing firm, because the One ahead of me never moves.
